units.rhetorical_move: a model is proposed in order to derive a quantitative expression
units.function: the aim is staged as deriving a number

original_instantiations: the model is offered so that a vague condition can be written as a number
the purpose is the number, not the method

units.source_excerpt: We propose an evaluation model in order to derive a quantitative expression of state fragility.
units.reusable_pattern: announce a model as a way to derive a number
reusable_elements: in order to derive a quantitative expression
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the model name

units.rhetorical_move: a framework is said to offer a distinct structure
units.function: a borrowed model is credited with clarity

original_instantiations: the imported framework is praised for making the links visible
the praise is the whole justification

units.source_excerpt: The model is applied in our model to offer a distinct framework of the relationship.
units.reusable_pattern: credit a borrowed framework with making the structure distinct
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the framework name

units.rhetorical_move: the three ranges are given as bare number pairs
units.function: a classification is delivered as three intervals

original_instantiations: each level is handed over as a pair of endpoints

units.source_excerpt: The corresponding results are 0.4991-1, 0.2196-0.4991, and 0-0.2196.
units.reusable_pattern: report a classification as three bare ranges
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the values

units.rhetorical_move: a fluctuation is said to stay inside a limited range
units.function: a movement is bounded before it is described

original_instantiations: the change is admitted but kept inside a small band
the band matters more than the direction

units.source_excerpt: We determine the fragility over five years, which shows a fluctuation in the limited fragile range.
units.reusable_pattern: bound a fluctuation to a limited range
reusable_elements: which shows a fluctuation in the limited range
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the country name

units.rhetorical_move: a result is said to be still regarded as vulnerable
units.function: a worsening is capped by a label

original_instantiations: the decline is granted and then stopped short of the next level

units.source_excerpt: Our model shows that the fragile situation is generally deteriorating but still regarded as vulnerable.
units.reusable_pattern: let a label cap a reported decline
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the country name

units.rhetorical_move: a cost is given and then the improvement as a percentage
units.function: a plan is closed with two numbers

original_instantiations: the spending and the gain are paired in one sentence
the percentage is the payoff of the sum

units.source_excerpt: The total cost of interventions is calculated, and the results show that the situation would be better after implementing interventions.
units.reusable_pattern: pair a cost with the percentage it buys
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the figures

units.rhetorical_move: a risk is said to pose threats to stability
units.function: the stakes are named in the first line

original_instantiations: the danger is aimed at both states and societies

units.source_excerpt: Climate-fragility risks pose threats to the stability of states and societies.
units.reusable_pattern: open by naming what the risk threatens
reusable_elements: pose threats to the stability of
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the subject wording

units.rhetorical_move: a problem is defined as a superimposition rather than a single cause

original_instantiations: the cause is said to be two things laid on each other, not either one alone

units.source_excerpt: We define the problem as the impact of superimposition of two cycles, rather than attribution of either one purely.
units.reusable_pattern: define a cause as a superimposition and reject the single attribution
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the subject wording

units.rhetorical_move: a finding is restated as that is to say
units.function: a citation is unpacked in plain words

original_instantiations: the quoted result is said again in the paper's own words

units.source_excerpt: It has been found that the impacts will augment existing pressures. That is to say that the dynamics may be exacerbated.
units.reusable_pattern: restate a cited finding with that is to say
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the citation

units.rhetorical_move: the reverse direction is added with vice versa

original_instantiations: the effect is said to run back the other way as well

units.source_excerpt: Vice versa, the downward trend of stability will also exacerbate the change.

units.source_excerpt: According to the problem, we are required to develop an appropriate model which contributes to the identification.
units.reusable_pattern: restate the assignment as what is required

units.source_excerpt: All these diverse indices are derived quantitatively. Nevertheless, scarcely do current indices take the factor into account, which becomes more and more non-negligible.
units.reusable_pattern: fault the prior indices for one growing omission

units.rhetorical_move: a logic is named as reason, effect, response
units.function: a method is reduced to three words

units.source_excerpt: Through the thinking logic of reason, effect and response, the model reflects the interaction.
units.reusable_pattern: compress a method into a three-word logic
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the model name

units.function: a framework is justified by the questions it settles

original_instantiations: three plain questions are offered as what the model answers

units.source_excerpt: The model answers the three basic questions, that is, what happened, why it happened, how we do it.
units.reusable_pattern: justify a framework by the three questions it answers
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the model name

units.rhetorical_move: a fit is called reasonable, so the reading follows
units.function: an analogy is licensed by agreement

original_instantiations: the match with the background is said to make the reading legitimate
the conclusion is the interpretation

units.source_excerpt: The mutual effect accords with the basic background of the model, which means that it is reasonable to interpret the relationship this way.
units.reusable_pattern: license an interpretation by an accord
reusable_elements: which means that it is reasonable to
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the model name

units.rhetorical_move: both scientificity and effectiveness are weighed while choosing
units.function: a selection is given two criteria

original_instantiations: the choice is said to balance rigour against what can actually be found

units.source_excerpt: While selecting the indicators, we give consideration to both scientificity and effectiveness, since it is kind of difficult to acquire the data.

reusable_elements: since it is kind of difficult
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the indicator names

units.rhetorical_move: a relation is called undoubtedly massively difficult
units.function: a quantification is declined as too hard

units.reusable_pattern: decline a quantification as massively difficult
reusable_elements: it is undoubtedly massively difficult to
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the system wording

units.function: a missing quantity is given a lesser job

units.source_excerpt: The indirect impact here is not equal to a quantitative impact but works as guidance for proceeding interventions instead.
units.reusable_pattern: demote a missing number to guidance
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the subject wording

units.rhetorical_move: a smaller entropy is said to mean more information and a higher weight
units.function: a chain of consequences is run in one sentence

original_instantiations: one smallness is followed through three consequences
each consequence is larger than the last

units.source_excerpt: If the information entropy of an indicator is smaller, the greater the amount of information, the greater the role, and the higher the weight.
units.reusable_pattern: run a chain of the-greater consequences from one premise
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the method name

units.rhetorical_move: a larger difference is said to count for more
units.function: importance is tied to spread

original_instantiations: the indicator that moves most is said to matter most

reusable_elements: the larger the difference, the more important it accounts for
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the method name

units.rhetorical_move: a disagreement is called reasonable

units.reusable_pattern: absorb a disagreement by calling the range reasonable
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the index name

units.function: one country is made the example

original_instantiations: a single case is said to show why the ranking moved

prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the country name

units.rhetorical_move: a shape is named with a letter
units.function: a fluctuation is described by its outline

original_instantiations: the movement is said to trace a letter and to fall overall

units.reusable_pattern: name the shape of a fluctuation with a letter
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the country name

units.rhetorical_move: a change is attributed to one group as a percentage

original_instantiations: most of the movement is traced to one of the three groups

original_instantiations: dropping in the list is taken to mean the condition eased

units.source_excerpt: The fragile situation is relatively dampened since its rank goes down, neglecting the impact.

original_instantiations: one case is judged worse by being set against the earlier one

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, we can conclude that during the years it suffered from a more severe threat than the earlier case.
units.reusable_pattern: judge a case by comparing it with the previous one
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the country names

units.function: a new term is pinned to an old number

original_instantiations: the boundary between two levels is renamed as the tipping point

units.source_excerpt: The tipping point is actually the boundary value between the two levels. Thereby, we define it as that value.

units.function: a forecast is turned into a warning

original_instantiations: the projected crossing is said to be unavoidable unless something is done

units.source_excerpt: Without additional interventions, this tendency is unpreventable in a way.

units.function: a shortcut is rejected for scale

prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the region name

units.rhetorical_move: the framework is kept and only the indicators are swapped
units.function: a modification is bounded

the bound is the point

units.source_excerpt: The overall framework can be maintained, that is, the categories and the weighting. For the national indicators, use the regional ones instead.

prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the indicator names

units.rhetorical_move: the selection is said to be as comprehensive as possible
units.function: effort is offered as a strength

original_instantiations: the care taken in choosing is itself the claim
the basis is a published index

units.source_excerpt: While selecting indicators, we consider as comprehensively and meticulously as possible.

reusable_elements: as comprehensively and meticulously as possible
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the index name

units.rhetorical_move: a similarity is called still holding despite restricted data

original_instantiations: the agreement survives even though the inputs were few
the limit is conceded first

units.source_excerpt: With a restricted number of indicators and data, the rank of our model is still similar to the published one.
units.reusable_pattern: concede the thin data and keep the agreement
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the index name

units.function: a flaw is owned and then excused

original_instantiations: the bias is admitted and blamed on the thin reading
the excuse follows at once

units.source_excerpt: Although referring to the literature, we still select the indicators with a subjective concept. This is unavoidable without enough literature.
units.reusable_pattern: own a bias and call it unavoidable
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the index name

units.rhetorical_move: a small sample is said to restrict the accuracy
units.function: a limit is pinned to a count

original_instantiations: the number of cases is blamed for the rough boundaries
the method is said not to save it

units.source_excerpt: The limited number of cases restricts the accuracy of the classification, even if we apply the analysis for a better one.
units.reusable_pattern: blame the accuracy on the number of cases
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the count

units.rhetorical_move: reliability is assumed only because time ran out
units.function: a shortcut is confessed

original_instantiations: the data is trusted for lack of time, and the trust is called unrealistic
the confession opens the future work

units.source_excerpt: Our model is built on the assumption that all the collected data is reliable due to the limited time, which is inconsistent with the real world.

prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the subject wording

each stage gets its own sentence

units.source_excerpt: To conclude, we first establish the model. Furthermore, we apply the analysis. Thereafter, we implement the instantiations.
units.reusable_pattern: close by replaying the stages in order
prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the method names

units.rhetorical_move: each source sits on its own numbered line
units.function: the list mixes reports, theses and journal pages

the kinds of source stay apart by entry

units.reusable_pattern: give each source its own numbered line
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat the list as prose
